scripts.dev: concurrently -n server,web,site -c green,cyan,magenta "NEXT_SITE_URL=http://localhost:3101 npm run dev -w @record-platform/server" "npm run dev -w @record-platform/web" "npm run dev -w @record-platform/site"
scripts.build: npm run build -w @record-platform/core && npm run build -w @record-platform/server && npm run build -w @record-platform/web && npm run build -w @record-platform/site && npm run build -w @record-platform/mcp
scripts.check: npm run check -w @record-platform/core && npm run check -w @record-platform/server && npm run check -w @record-platform/web && npm run check -w @record-platform/site && npm run check -w @record-platform/mcp
